// diagnostic E1330

Jet.InvalidTaskMetadata

Task metadata or a task path is invalid

What

Task metadata or a task path is invalid

Why

Task packages, cache inputs/outputs, cwd, and limits must be deterministic and project-contained.

Fix

Use the typed metadata shape and project-relative paths without `..`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidTaskMetadata: Tests/UI/task_metadata_invalid_e1330.stderr.

Error: Jet.InvalidTaskMetadata: Task metadata parallel has the wrong shape
  --> task_metadata_invalid_e1330.jet:1:16
    |
  1 | #Job(parallel: 0)
    |                ^
 Why: Parallel is a positive integer or none
 Fix: Write parallel: as a positive integer or none
